job.title: Software Engineer Specialist - Full Stack @ Esko (KA, IN)
job.description:
**Software Engineer Specialist - Full Stack**

**Location:** India  
**Function:** Engineering  
**Reports To:** Senior Engineering Manager

Are you...

* Interested in building scalable, reliable customer-facing cloud applications that help teams manage packaging artwork, collaboration, and approvals?
* Passionate about hands-on full stack software engineering, modern web technologies, distributed systems, and solving complex technical problems?
* Excited to take broader technical ownership across the frontend and backend, deliver intuitive product experiences, and raise the engineering bar across the team?

If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our products help packaging teams collaborate, review artwork, and manage approvals with greater speed and confidence. WebCenter Go combines flexible approval workflows, artwork proofing and version comparison, project analytics and reporting, and AI-powered compliance checks in a customer-facing cloud product. In this role, you will help turn complex customer needs into simple, intuitive product experiences.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Software Engineer Specialist – Full Stack** to help build and evolve customer-facing Esko SaaS products, including WebCenter Go.

This is a deeply hands-on technical role spanning modern web applications, backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You will partner closely with Architects, Product and UX while bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions and owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, performance, and operational readiness of complex capabilities.

You are expected to make sound technical decisions independently, navigate ambiguity, and balance engineering quality with pragmatic, fast execution.

You will work on customer-facing product capabilities such as artwork review and proofing, approval workflows, version comparison, and project visibility. WebCenter Go brings packaging collaboration, flexible workflows, and AI-powered checks into one controlled space. You will remain deeply hands-on while mentoring engineers, solving complex technical problems, and delivering intuitive, reliable user experiences.

What You Will Do

* Design, build, and evolve scalable full stack product features and customer-facing cloud applications.
* Own complex product capabilities end-to-end, from detailed technical design through frontend and backend implementation to production readiness.
* Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex technical problems across the stack.
* Partner with Architects, Product and UX to translate customer needs and product direction into production software, making pragmatic technical decisions and identifying trade-offs.
* Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, testability and maintainability of our applications and services.
* Lead technical problem-solving, design and code reviews, and resolution of complex production issues.
* Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and champion modern development practices, including effective use of AI-assisted development.

Required Experience

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building full stack, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, including modern frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, asynchronous programming, performance optimization and automated testing.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks, designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing and building multi-tenant SaaS applications, with a strong understanding of scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, fault tolerance and tenant isolation.
* Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations across frontend and backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex technical problems from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation and production, making pragmatic trade-offs and challenging assumptions where appropriate.
* Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform, with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git and modern software delivery practices, including automated testing across frontend, API and backend layers.
* Experience diagnosing complex production and performance problems across the stack using browser developer tools, profiling, logs, metrics and distributed tracing.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, hands-on collaboration and sound engineering judgement.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with advanced browser technologies such as WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, Service Workers, IndexedDB, WebSockets, Streams or similar Web APIs, particularly for building high-performance or computationally intensive web applications.
* Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts.
* Hands-on experience with Python in addition to Java/JVM and frontend technologies.
* Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies.
* Experience building customer-facing product capabilities, reusable UI components or design systems that support consistent, intuitive user experiences.
* Experience modernizing customer-facing web applications or large-scale distributed systems and improving engineering practices across teams.
* Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools and helping engineering teams adopt and scale these practices across coding, testing, debugging, documentation and code review.

What Success Looks Like

* You can take a complex product capability and drive its technical implementation end-to-end, from the browser through APIs and backend services to production.
* Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations.
* Customer-facing web applications and supporting services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable and maintainable while delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences.
* Complex engineering problems across frontend, backend, and distributed systems are resolved with strong technical judgement and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers.
* Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, design discussions, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance.
* Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation.
* Engineers around you make effective use of modern development practices, including AI-assisted development, to improve productivity and quality without compromising engineering discipline.
* You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgement, full stack technical depth, pragmatic decision-making, and the ability to turn complex problems into high-quality solutions quickly.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

**Unsolicited Assistance**

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

job.title: Developer @ Arctic Wolf Networks (KA, IN)
job.description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Full Stack Developer,** to be a part of making this happen.

**Position Overview and Objective**

Our **Exposure Management Platform team** owns the shared frontend foundation — component library, build tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure for our Portals. What we build is used broadly enough that good decisions scale well and poor ones surface quickly.

We're looking for a **Full Stack Developer** who is energized by that kind of leverage. You'll spend as much time understanding *why* something is broken as fixing it, writing the governance and tooling that prevents the next problem, and being a trusted technical partner to the feature teams who depend on what we build.

This role requires deep expertise in **React, TypeScript** , and good experience and interest with **Backend services(Go, Node js…)** including building Backend for Frontend layers, along with a strong focus on engineering excellence, performance, scalability, and developer experience. You’ll be expected to demonstrate frontend best practices and architectural patterns, and help drive operational excellence across our frontend systems.

**Responsibilities**

As a **Full Stack Developer** at Arctic Wolf, you will:

* Design and develop scalable, high-performance frontend architectures and Portals using **React and TypeScript.**
* Investigate systemic issues across the platform - audit unfamiliar codebases, identify root causes, and produce written findings and architectural recommendations before proposing solutions.
* Build and maintain **Node.js /Go - based backend services** supporting frontend platforms (e.g., BFFs, APIs, tooling services).
* Champion **developer experience (DX) and frontend standards** through automation, documentation, and tooling.
* Guide developers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing. Be a Vocal member on frontend architecture, platform standards, testing strategies, and engineering best practices.
* Identify friction in the development lifecycle and lead platform improvement initiatives that enhance usability, adoption, reliability, and developer productivity.
* Optimize application performance, bundle size, and runtime efficiency.
* Drive adoption of modern frontend technologies and engineering practices.
* Act as a technical partner to feature teams — balancing platform stability and backward compatibility with the ability to evolve APIs and patterns over time.
* Contribute to Agile development processes including sprint planning, retrospectives, and iterative delivery practices.
Contribute to long-term technical strategy through written proposals and cross-team architecture conversations.  

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years** of software development experience.
* Strong Fundamentals in HTML, CSS, Javascript and Web Architectures.
* Strong expertise in **TypeScript** and **React** (hooks, state management, performance).
* **Monorepo experience** at scale (we use Nx — familiarity with task graphs and affected builds is a plus).
* **Server-state management and client-side routing** in a large React application.
* Hands-on experience with **Node.js** and backend service development including Go.
* Experience with **testing infrastructure** : unit, component, and E2E (Vitest, Playwright, or equivalents).
* Demonstrated ability to independently investigate a complex codebase and produce clear written architectural assessments - not just code fixes.
Ability to balance ideal architecture with real-world constraints, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and effectively context-switch across multiple initiatives when urgent platform needs arise.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with:
  + Design systems and component libraries (Storybook, etc.)
  + Monorepos (Nx, Turborepo, Lerna)
  + CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or similar)
  + TanStack Query and Router
* Deep understanding of:
  + Web performance optimization
  + Cross-browser compatibility
  + Accessibility (a11y) best practices
* Experience building developer tools (CLI tools, plugins, linters, codemods)
* Experience with frontend build tools and bundlers (Webpack, Vite, Rollup, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL)
* Knowledge of SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js or similar)
* Exposure to micro-frontend architectures
* Cloud experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Strong understanding of observability and monitoring tools , Ex: Sentry  

  

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

All **India** wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
Employee Assistance Program  

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

**Security Requirements**

* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================
